about.heading: Why Choose Legacy Financial Planning for Your Financial Journey?
about.text: At Legacy Financial Planning, we believe true financial security comes from a holistic approach that considers every aspect of your financial well-being. Our dedicated team is committed to guiding you through a comprehensive strategy focused on three key pillars: protecting your hard-earned money, strategically growing your wealth for the future, and ensuring your legacy is secure through meticulous estate planning. We work tirelessly to ensure that when it comes to your financial future, no family is left behind.

team_intro.heading: Meet the Legacy Financial Planning Team
team_intro.text: Behind every successful financial plan is a trusted partnership. Meet the advisors of Legacy Financial Planning, united in our commitment to protect, grow, and secure your family's wealth.

team.name: Ly Dich
team.bio: Before entering the world of finance, Ly spent several years as a teacher — an experience that shaped his deep appreciation for education, clear communication, and lifelong learning. Ly believes that financial confidence starts with understanding, and he is passionate about helping individuals and families make informed decisions that align with their goals and values. Whether you're planning for the future or navigating life's unexpected turns, Ly is here to offer guidance, clarity, and support every step of the way.

team.name: Anson Hardjojo
team.bio: Anson helps clients build a strong financial foundation through education, focusing on long-term growth and security. He is passionate about empowering families to achieve their retirement dreams while ensuring their current assets remain protected.
